translations.web: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
translations.bsb: Leah said, “How happy I am! For the women call me happy.” So she named him Asher.
translations.kjv: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
